ios.desc:
Pyxis: Travel Journal helps you save the places that matter with notes, photos, weather, and travel details all in one place.

Save meaningful locations, add notes, attach photos, and  build a personal collection of memories, plans, and favorite spots. Whether you are planning your next trip, documenting places you have already been, or saving meaningful moments from everyday life, Pyxis keeps everything beautifully organized and easy to revisit.

Now, with deep Siri integration that allows the system to provide context to your notes, locations, tasks, and tags. You can use Foundation Models to identify locations in images and add them to your collections. Try this with screenshots from social media feeds and real life images. Identified locations can prepare a new note, while Siri, Shortcuts, and Spotlight make saved places, tasks, and tags easier to find and use.

With Pyxis, you can:
• Save locations with notes and photos for added context
• Create and manage task lists for each saved place
• Download maps for offline access when internet is unavailable
• View routing and travel time for your saved locations
• Check current weather and the 7-day forecast for any location
• Review historical weather to better plan future visits
• Explore sunrise, sunset, and day length across an interactive yearly chart, alongside moonrise and moonset details
• Mark places you have visited and keep track of where to go next
• Share polished location images with family and friends, including maps, coordinates, notes, photos, tags, and place details
• Recover coordinates and visible notes when a Pyxis shared image returns through photo recognition on the latest OS release
• Organize places with customizable tags using colors and symbols
• Get smarter tag suggestions based on note, place, weather, and time context
• Sort and filter places by tags, dates, and visited status
• Sync your collection across devices with iCloud
• Export your notes and photos locally and restore them later
• Search nearby places and quickly add them to your collection
• Use Siri and Shortcuts to add and find places, manage visits and tasks, check weather, open tags, start routes, and identify locations from images
• Find saved places, tags, and tasks with Spotlight and open them at the right destination
• Hear clearer VoiceOver summaries and get more helpful empty states across notes, tags, and searches

quotes.text:
An iOS app made for saving locations. It’s called Pyxis: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/travel-journal-pyxis/id6639617144

I’m not a developer by trade but I’ve been learning iOS dev for about 6 years now. It’s become my project that I just keep working at since I personally use it a lot.

The app lets you save your favorite locations, add notes to them, add photos, check weather, tag them for better organization, and archive those tags for future trips. You can also mark off locations that you’ve been to already: think breweries or a coffee shop when visiting a new city.

For the next update, I’m working on a task list functionality for each location. The idea came as a shopping list based on which stores I go to but it can work for any other context as well. This way I can get rid of my shopping list from my task apps.

In terms of weather, I’m also adding historical averages to the forecast to have some sort of context to the weather.

Also leaning more into marketing these days (hence this post) and designing a new icon with some custom art work to give the product some sort of personality. I started learning affinity design to just do it myself so I learn some design software along the way.

Anyways, if you download it, I’d love to hear some feedback. :)
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (January 2026)
